mode: builtin imagegen; theme variants referenced furniture-haunted-v1.png; transparent background
cozy:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit the supplied moon-tavern furniture atlas into a complete new themed tile atlas for the same pixel-art game. Preserve its professional hand-painted pixel-art style: stepped dark outlines, restrained highlights, readable material shading, slightly elevated front-facing perspective. This is a full expanded theme variant, with new materials and joinery, not a global tint. NO room scene or UI.
Output a SQUARE transparent atlas with exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, sixteen equal cells. Every asset fully isolated and centered in its own cell with generous transparent gutters; none touch neighboring cells. No text, numbers, labels, grids or watermarks.
Exact layout:
Row 1: (1) plain square kitchen floor texture tile viewed straight from above; (2) square dining floor wood-plank texture tile straight from above with only two broad horizontal planks; (3) square front-facing structural wall panel, upper wall and lower wooden wainscot, straight edges for repeating; (4) complete wall window.
Row 2: (1) center bar/cabinet counter module; (2) matching left end counter module; (3) matching right end counter module; (4) very wide two-person rectangular dining table, approximately 2.3:1 overall width to height.
Row 3: (1) full dining chair facing front, with backrest, visible seat cushion and feet; (2) tall round bar stool with visible seat and feet; (3) one small themed floor decoration; (4) a simple rectangular flat woven rug, solid field and a single narrow border, absolutely no busy center pattern.
Row 4: (1) wall-mounted two-door storage cabinet; (2) small hanging wall lantern; (3) small wooden barrel; (4) small wall noticeboard with blank papers, no readable writing.
Counters have a clearly readable top surface taking about one third of their height, and a full cabinet front below. They share identical dimensions and top heights, so they can join edge to edge. No bottles, crockery, food, accessories, shadows or objects on top of counters/table/chairs. No spoon or characters. Chair seat is approximately two thirds down the source sprite; stool seat is near its top. Consistent pixel density across all items, not photorealistic. Simple quiet floor textures, no star/floral floor emblems, no excessive grain, no glossy gradients, no background haze. True transparent background; opaque square floor tiles themselves.
Theme: COZY VILLAGE PUB. Warm honey oak and chestnut cabinets with inset rectangular wood panels, modest brass knobs, cream stone counter tops with an amber oak edge. Warm pale plaster walls with oak wainscot and beams. Kitchen tile is quiet warm ivory travertine with thin taupe grout. Dining planks are warm honey oak with minimal grain. Window is a friendly square-paned arched oak window with warm golden daylight, NOT a moon window. Table has a honey-oak top and turned chestnut legs. Dining chair has a cream linen cushion and curved oak back; stool matches. Floor decoration is a modest sage herb planter. Rug is muted terracotta/rose with cream edging. Wall cabinet is cream/oak, lantern warm brass. Barrel honey oak with dark iron hoops. Muted natural colors, cream, honey wood, faded terracotta and sage. Retain the existing moon atlas's crisp craftsmanship and shading style, but replace all moon/star motifs with plain village woodworking.
